headline: Earnings grow again as guidance is reaffirmed
summary_short: Atmos Energy's net income rose 30% y/y to $242.7 million and diluted EPS grew 23% to $1.43 for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company reaffirmed fiscal 2026 diluted EPS guidance of $8.40-$8.50 and guided fiscal 2026 capex to about $4.2 billion.
summary_long: Net income grew 30% y/y to $242.7 million and diluted EPS rose 23% to $1.43 for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, alongside operating income up 27% to $320.4 million and EBITDA up 17% to $537.9 million; the release does not explain the quarterly moves beyond citing $355.0 million in new annualized regulatory rate outcomes implemented fiscal year-to-date. Total cash fell 27% y/y to $521.0 million while shareholders' equity rose 14% to $15.26 billion. Fiscal YTD capex was $3.1 billion (>85% safety/reliability). The Board declared a $1.00 quarterly dividend (+14.9% annualized y/y) and reaffirmed fiscal 2026 diluted EPS guidance of $8.40-$8.50, guiding fiscal 2026 capex to approximately $4.2 billion.
